policy: Only successful execution against pinned, unmodified Pi establishes the scoped differential contract. Catalog inclusion, copied expected outputs, skipped tests and gaps are never parity evidence.
core_policy: The kernel owns generic request/event/action/history/cancellation/lifetime contracts only. Provider protocols/auth/catalogs, persistence, tools, resources, UI and policy are replaceable extensions. Existing code-mode and provider APIs remain backward compatible.

projection.registry: Ordered provider IDs and complete model metadata; no field filtering.
projection.dispatch: Text and stop category only for injected scripted backends. Provider wire/auth/stream behavior remains a separate gap.
projection.store: Complete JSON-compatible snapshots, including nested unknown metadata.
projection.excluded: These scenarios do not exhaust Pi APIs. --require-complete fails until inventory_complete and every capability is covered.

capabilities.scope: Insertion order, replacement by ID, removal, clearing and isolation of explicit registries; not provider implementation parity.
capabilities.differential: Execute the same seeded register/replace/delete/clear/read sequences against Pi createModels and Julia ProviderRegistry; compare ordered observations.

capabilities.scope: Provider-owned metadata and lookup by provider, model ID and operation type; no image/classifier execution claim.
capabilities.differential: Execute mixed chat/image/classifier catalogs, shared IDs, unknown providers and missing models; compare complete metadata and order.

capabilities.scope: Generic dispatch to a replaceable selected backend, including replacement generation; text completion projection with a scripted dependency only.
capabilities.differential: Inject equivalent scripted provider dependencies; execute Pi Models.complete and Julia respond after replacement; compare text and stop category. Network protocol, auth, usage, tools and event order are separate obligations.

capabilities.scope: A failing catalog callback cannot hide another provider catalog.
capabilities.differential: Inject a throwing catalog alongside healthy catalogs, then compare scoped and aggregate lookup behavior.

capabilities.scope: Provider-scoped in-memory cache with defensive read/write copies; cancellation and persistence excluded.
capabilities.differential: Execute real stores, mutate caller input and returned snapshots, delete one provider and read both; compare every subsequent observation.

capabilities.scope: Opaque ETag, timestamps and nested extension metadata survive cache round trips.
capabilities.differential: Round-trip quoted weak validators, Unicode, timestamps and nested unknown fields through both stores; compare without filtering fields.

capabilities.scope: Lossless multimodal content, thinking signatures, tool-call IDs/results and system/tool changes at model boundaries.
capabilities.differential: Replay the same multimodal transcript, model switches, empty tool results and mid-conversation system/tool changes; compare wire requests and normalized responses, preserving signatures and IDs.

capabilities.scope: Ordered text/thinking/tool argument deltas, terminal results, errors, cancellation and disposal.
capabilities.differential: Feed identical fragmented transport bytes, malformed final arguments, disconnects and cancellation schedules to both real streams; compare event order, immutable partial snapshots, terminal messages and cleanup.

capabilities.scope: Generic options, usage/cost/stop/error contracts and capability negotiation without provider branches in the kernel.
capabilities.differential: Apply the same option sets to corresponding adapters; compare requests, usage/cache tokens, stop reasons and structured errors; test unsupported capabilities explicitly.

capabilities.scope: OpenAI-compatible wire behavior, not endpoint or provider names.
capabilities.differential: Use a local HTTP server with identical text, thinking, tool, usage, malformed, HTTP-error and interrupted SSE cassettes; compare captured request bodies/auth, response blocks and ordered events from both real adapters.

capabilities.scope: Responses tools, deferred results, cache-preserving updates and usage.
capabilities.differential: Replay Responses cassettes including additional_tools, removals, reasoning, errors and deferred completion; compare actual requests and stream results.

capabilities.scope: Anthropic Messages, thinking, cache control and strict tool fallback.
capabilities.differential: Replay Anthropic SSE and strict-tool rejection/retry; compare auth, body, thinking signatures, image tool results, cache accounting and retry requests.

capabilities.scope: Google Generative AI and Vertex protocols, auth and thinking options.
capabilities.differential: Replay Gemini tool/thought/image streams and Vertex credential refresh; compare requests, schema conversion, signatures and ordered results for each family.

capabilities.scope: AWS credentials, Converse event streams, reasoning and strict tool fallback.
capabilities.differential: Run both against deterministic AWS credential and Converse endpoints; compare signed request semantics, binary event decoding, strict-tool retry and terminal errors.

capabilities.scope: Azure deployment URL, auth/version configuration and Responses events.
capabilities.differential: Compare captured requests and response traces for identical deployment, endpoint, credentials and cassettes; include invalid deployment/auth and cancellation.

capabilities.scope: Codex Responses HTTP/WebSocket transport, OAuth and reconnects; the existing CLI adapter is not equivalent.
capabilities.differential: Use scripted HTTP/WebSocket servers with OAuth, incremental tools, reconnects and usage-limit failures; compare requests, retry decisions and events.

capabilities.scope: Per-model API routing, Claude aliases/signatures, usage and attribution.
capabilities.differential: Execute actual factories for compatible and Anthropic-routed models; compare selected API, thinking preservation, headers, costs and errors.

capabilities.scope: Every other built-in provider has an individual behavior obligation; catalog inclusion is not coverage.
capabilities.differential: Enumerate upstream factories and require provider-specific auth/config/request/response cassettes for each. Shared-protocol tests alone do not cover provider-specific options/auth.

capabilities.scope: Injectable credential storage, API keys, OAuth, ambient credentials and secret-safe enumeration.
capabilities.differential: Run matching read/modify/delete/list and auth-resolution operations with injected stores/environments; compare results and side effects without real secrets.

capabilities.scope: Single-flight rotation, cancelled callers, failed refresh preservation and login/logout races.
capabilities.differential: Control concurrent refresh/login/logout with barriers and scripted OAuth; compare refresh count, surviving rotated token, cancellation results and stored credentials.

capabilities.scope: Device-code flags, URL validation, prompts and secure persistence.
capabilities.differential: Replay auth events and malicious URI/control-character inputs; compare prompts, browser/clipboard side effects and file permissions in isolated directories.

capabilities.scope: Cache-first refresh, conditional HTTP, availability filters and stale publication rejection.
capabilities.differential: Use identical cache/ETag/304/error inputs and overlapping refresh/replacement/cancel barriers; compare publication, persistence, request count and retained last-good state.

capabilities.scope: Image generation and structured classification including image input.
capabilities.differential: Execute real operations using identical fixtures/unavailable models; compare payloads, outputs, usage and errors, not catalog types alone.

capabilities.scope: Deferred fetch/cancel handles, polling and terminal outcomes.
capabilities.differential: Replay pending/ready/failed/cancelled handles with a virtual clock; compare poll requests, preserved metadata and cleanup.

capabilities.scope: Agent/turn/message/tool order, validation, parallel/sequential execution and exactly-once results.
capabilities.differential: Inject identical model streams/tools into both real loops; compare complete ordered event traces, validation failures, side effects and persisted messages.

capabilities.scope: Steering/follow-up queues, continuation, retries and cancellation boundaries.
capabilities.differential: Schedule identical steering/follow-up/cancel inputs while tools and models wait at barriers; compare dequeue timing, skipped calls and history.

capabilities.scope: Generic context conversion and composable before/after request hooks.
capabilities.differential: Install competing transforms/hooks; compare ordering, veto/rewrites, tool overrides and model-visible messages, preserving custom messages.

capabilities.scope: Stable identity, parent links, revisions, branch/fork and projection.
capabilities.differential: Replay append/edit/branch/fork/model-change traces; normalize only generated IDs by bijection and timestamps; compare context and all tree relationships.

capabilities.scope: JSONL storage, resume, migration, labels, custom entries and exports.
capabilities.differential: Write/reload versioned fixtures including truncated final records; compare tree, context, metadata, migration and export contents in temporary directories.

capabilities.scope: Automatic/manual compaction, branch summaries, overflow recovery and custom boundaries.
capabilities.differential: Use deterministic summaries/token usage on matching trees; compare cut points, retained tool pairs, system state, usage and abort/failure rollback.

capabilities.scope: Ordered interception, veto/rewrite semantics and cleanup.
capabilities.differential: Register competing hooks/replacements, unload during execution, and compare ordering, transformations, vetoes, retained generations and cleanup.

capabilities.scope: Discovery, isolation, update/reload, commands, flags and renderers.
capabilities.differential: Use local packages/fake registries; compare discovery precedence, collisions, update/cache behavior, reload state and command dispatch.

capabilities.scope: Discovery, skills, templates, project context and collision diagnostics.
capabilities.differential: Load identical temporary project/user/package fixtures, symlinks and duplicates; compare precedence, expansions, diagnostics and reload.

capabilities.scope: Explicit project trust and untrusted resource gating.
capabilities.differential: Replay decisions including AGENTS-only projects, case/symlink variants and saved distrust; compare resource loading and permission-sensitive side effects.

capabilities.scope: Cancellation and operation-scoped release with retained plugin generations.
capabilities.differential: Apply identical ownership/close/cancel sequences with instrumented cleanup; compare counts and ordering, including replacement while active.

capabilities.scope: Read/write/edit/bash/PowerShell/grep/find/ls, truncation, mutation serialization and cleanup.
capabilities.differential: Run both tool sets on copied temporary filesystems and controlled child processes; compare output/details/errors, truncation, file bytes and process-group cleanup.

capabilities.scope: MCP tools/resources/prompts, transport lifecycle, OAuth and discovery.
capabilities.differential: Use a deterministic MCP server covering pagination, calls, resources/prompts, reconnect, cancellation and OAuth URL checks; compare protocol traces and agent-visible results.

capabilities.scope: Code workers, tool search/exposure, subagents and model operations.
capabilities.differential: Use identical tool catalogs/scripts/queries and worker limits; compare Unicode ranking, queued work, calls/results and cancellation. Existing Julia execution alone is not equivalence.

capabilities.scope: SDK composition, JSON/RPC commands/events, print output and exit/error behavior.
capabilities.differential: Drive actual frontends with identical JSON commands and scripted models; compare responses/events/state/stdout/stderr/exit status, normalizing only declared generated IDs.

capabilities.scope: Editing, autocomplete, keybindings, selectors, rendering, auth and extension UI.
capabilities.differential: Replay terminal input/resize/image/control sequences in pseudo-terminals; compare semantic screen snapshots, commands and side effects for matching session state.

capabilities.scope: Retry policy, identity/header transforms and content-safe telemetry.
capabilities.differential: Use matching failures, Retry-After, virtual clocks, identity overrides and telemetry sinks; compare retry count/delay, headers and redacted events.
